lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three nights north of {village}, the hunters are still behind {mc}.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two others keep pace in the dark. They followed {them} out of the village and will not go back.

lines.speaker: hask
lines.text: They've got dogs now. I heard them at the last ford.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: Then go home, Hask. They want the sword, not you.

lines.speaker: hask
lines.text: Home's ash. You saw the smoke same as we did.

lines.speaker: lise
lines.text: Hunters behind us, and more ahead if they have any sense. The river road is the only way north.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: They follow me. Not you. Not them.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: Then be quiet, and they might lose us.

lines.speaker: lise
lines.text: Past the bridge the forest runs all the way to the old border. They won't find us in there.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: West of the road stand the bones of a border fort. Someone has lit a fire inside.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: Hunters, or someone hiding from them.

lines.speaker: lise
lines.text: Either way, we cross before dawn.
